Hyper.name: The Revolution Letter
Hyper.prompt: A morning assault on the Capital Builing was a failure. The leader of the revolution has been captured. You, a reporter who has been covering the revolution, have been assigned to write the news brief, keeping in mind the many readers and their perspectives.

Concrete.name: Many Voices in Space
Concrete.prompt: Many voices have rallied around your last post. You note their diverse reactions in your journal. (Explore this editor by writing in different locations.)

Three.name: Social Imagination
Three.prompt: As the news continues to proliferate, you imagine your words overlapping and merging with the many voices of the day. Illustrate this in words.
